rules.text:
Transmuted Spell
Cost: 1 Sorcery Point
When you cast a spell that deals a type of damage
from the following list, you can spend 1 Sorcery
Point to change that damage type to one of the
other listed types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder.

effects: Change that damage type to another listed type for exact cast; preserve other types and all targets
authored_operations.ending_and_identity: Capture edits on exact cast; preserve dice/targets/recipients through settlement; pay once after legal selection.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Map exact option onto every eligible in-band spell payload/host; existing native support is bounded, not universal. Do not mutate global spell definitions.
